'''Filata''' was a celestial body that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. At [[Site-145]] on the [[Third moon of Filata|third moon]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sokiro Terebin]] unearthed [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] that contained crystalline [[resonator]]s attuned to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
